validation.atLeastOneLine: Add at least one line item.
validation.duplicate: This value is already in use.

validation.pwMix: Include at least one letter and one digit.

validation.unknownBranch: Pick a branch that can hold stock (not the head office).
validation.sameBranch: Choose a different branch — goods can't move to where they already are.
validation.lostNote: Explain the loss in at least 10 characters (GD / insurance reference).
validation.unitCode: 1–12 letters, digits or dots, starting with a letter (e.g. Kg, Pcs, Sq.m).
validation.unitInUse: This unit is used by items — its code can't change.
validation.unknownUnit: Pick an active unit from the Units master.
validation.branchInUse: This branch has documents and stock history — it can't become an office.
validation.exceedsRemaining: More than the quantity left to return
validation.notApproved: Only approved purchases can be returned
validation.lcAfterBoe: LC date must be on or before the Bill of Entry date
validation.overrideReason: Give a reason for rates that differ from the tariff
validation.notInTariff: HS code not found in the NBR tariff
validation.foreignService: Foreign vendors cannot supply a local service purchase
validation.inputsOnly: Choose a raw-material or input item
validation.toBeforeFrom: End date is before the start date
validation.beforePurchase: Date is before the purchase date
validation.exportRequired: Export documents (LC, Bill of Export) are required for a foreign customer.
validation.deemedLocalOnly: A deemed export must be to a local (BIN-registered) customer.
validation.exportForeignOnly: A direct export must be to a foreign customer.
validation.lcAfterInvoice: The LC date cannot be after the invoice date.
validation.beforeInvoice: Cannot be before the invoice date.
validation.unknownBatch: This batch has no stock of the item.
validation.exceedsLot: More than is left in this batch.
validation.beforeSale: Cannot be before the sale date.
validation.amendmentReason: Explain why the declaration is being amended.
validation.afterPrevious: Must be after the effective date of the current version.
validation.pricePositive: The declared price must be above zero.
validation.noBom: This item has no approved price declaration (BOM).
validation.beforeIssue: Cannot be before the issue date.
validation.exceedsIssue: Received + damaged cannot exceed the quantity issued.
validation.exceedsWorkOrder: More than is left on the work order.
validation.lineCount: The number of lines doesn't match the batch.
validation.accountMismatch: This account doesn't match the payment method.
validation.advanceNotAllowed: Advances are turned off — allocate the full amount to invoices.
validation.beforePeriodEnd: Not before the end of the tax period.
validation.chargeOverAmount: The charge can't be more than the amount.
validation.dateClosed: This date is in a closed accounting period.
validation.exceedsDue: More than the amount due on this invoice.
validation.exceedsVds: More than the VAT still to withhold on this invoice.
validation.future: The date can't be in the future.
validation.notVds: This invoice has no VDS-applicable VAT.
validation.overAllocated: Allocations add up to more than the amount.
validation.periodLocked: This tax period is locked — its Mushak 9.1 return was submitted.
validation.refundExceeds: The refund can't be more than the closing balance.
validation.refundNotRequested: Turn on the refund request first.
validation.accessPast: The date cannot be in the past.
validation.accessTooLong: Access can be granted for at most 90 days.
validation.expiryBeforeDate: Expiry must be on or after the UD date.
validation.notExporter: This customer is not marked as an exporter (set the exporter type on the customer).
validation.udInUse: Already used on invoices — cannot change.
validation.belowUsed: Cannot go below the quantity already supplied.
validation.exceedsOutstanding: More than the amount still outstanding.
validation.customerMode: Customers must be registered (Local) or foreign.
validation.sdNoSd: No supplementary duty was paid on this purchase line.
validation.sdWindow: The export must be shipped within six months of the purchase.
validation.sdPeriodBeforeExport: The tax period cannot be before the export.
validation.sdExceeds: More than the SD-paid quantity still unclaimed.
validation.sdClaimLapsed: The six-month window of this purchase has ended — its SD can no longer be claimed.
validation.unknownUd: No UD / UP with this number is on file — add it under Bond consumption → UD settlement
validation.settledUd: This UD / UP is already settled — documents can no longer be added to it

Exports use bonded stock first (oldest Bill of Entry first), then duty-paid imports, then local stock. A shortfall means the bond book shows more than the stock on hand — the Bond Commissionerate charges full duty on it at the audit. Duty-paid and local inputs are listed too (s.114(3)).

VAT and AT are already input credit in the return, SD on exported inputs is taken back through Mushak 9.1 note 40, and AIT is an income-tax advance, so none of them is counted here.
